site.name: DevToolBox
site.tagline: Free online developer tools — no sign-up, no installs. Just open and use.
site.description: Free online developer tools: JSON formatter, Base64 encoder, URL encoder, regex tester, timestamp converter and more. No sign-up required.
site.about_p1: DevToolBox is a collection of free online utilities for software developers. All tools run entirely in your browser — your data never leaves your device.
site.about_p2_suffix: tools including JSON formatting, Base64 encoding, URL encoding, regular expression testing, and Unix timestamp conversion. More tools are added regularly.
site.footer: DevToolBox. Free developer tools — no sign-up required.

json-formatter.name: JSON Formatter
json-formatter.description: Format, minify, and validate JSON with syntax highlighting.
json-formatter.page_desc: Paste your JSON to format, validate, and explore with a tree view. Data stays in your browser.
json-formatter.seo_desc: Format, beautify, minify, and validate JSON online. Free developer tool — no sign-up required.
json-formatter.placeholder: Paste JSON on the left to see results
json-formatter.faq_text: JSON (JavaScript Object Notation) is a lightweight data interchange format widely used in web APIs and configuration files. This tool helps you format, beautify, minify, and validate JSON data in your browser. Your data stays local and is never sent to any server.
features: Real-time JSON validation with error position highlighting
Interactive tree view with collapsible nodes
Format with configurable indentation (2, 4, or 8 spaces)
Minify JSON to reduce file size
Copy formatted or minified output with one click

base64.name: Base64 Encode / Decode
base64.description: Encode text to Base64 or decode Base64 back to plain text.
base64.page_desc: Encode text to Base64 or decode Base64 strings instantly.
base64.seo_desc: Encode text to Base64 or decode Base64 back to plain text. Supports Unicode and CJK characters.
base64.encode_error: Failed to encode — input may contain unsupported characters.
base64.decode_error: Failed to decode — input is not valid Base64.
base64.faq_text: Base64 is a binary-to-text encoding scheme that represents binary data as an ASCII string. It is commonly used to embed binary data in JSON, HTML, emails, and URLs. This tool supports full Unicode text including CJK characters.

url-encoder.name: URL Encoder / Decoder
url-encoder.description: Encode or decode URLs and query string parameters.
url-encoder.page_desc: Encode or decode URLs and query string parameters.
url-encoder.seo_desc: Encode or decode URLs and query string parameters. Supports encodeURIComponent and encodeURI.
url-encoder.faq_text: URL encoding (percent-encoding) replaces unsafe characters with a % followed by two hex digits. encodeURIComponent encodes everything except A-Z a-z 0-9 - _ . ! ~ * ' ( ), making it ideal for query parameters. encodeURI preserves URI structure characters like : / ? # &.

regex-tester.name: Regex Tester
regex-tester.description: Test regular expressions against text with real-time match highlighting.
regex-tester.page_desc: Test regular expressions with real-time match highlighting.
regex-tester.seo_desc: Test JavaScript regular expressions with real-time match highlighting and capture group display.
regex-tester.test_placeholder: Type text to test against the regex pattern...
regex-tester.faq_text: This tool lets you test JavaScript-compatible regular expressions in real time. Matches are highlighted in the test string, and capture groups are shown in the results table. Supports global (g), case-insensitive (i), multiline (m), dotAll (s), and unicode (u) flags.

timestamp.name: Timestamp Converter
timestamp.description: Convert between Unix timestamps and human-readable dates.
timestamp.page_desc: Convert between Unix timestamps and human-readable dates.
timestamp.seo_desc: Convert between Unix timestamps and human-readable dates. Supports seconds, milliseconds, and ISO 8601.
timestamp.input_label: Enter a Unix timestamp or date string
timestamp.empty_error: Please enter a timestamp or date string.
timestamp.parse_error: Unable to parse input. Try a Unix timestamp or ISO 8601 date.
timestamp.faq_text: A Unix timestamp is the number of seconds since January 1, 1970 00:00:00 UTC (the Unix Epoch). This tool converts between Unix timestamps (seconds or milliseconds) and human-readable date formats including ISO 8601, UTC, and your local timezone.
